text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- Capital market regulator CNVM adopted norms for operation of institutions behind over-the-counter market to be launched later this month.
- Raising of 30 billion yen in Samurai bonds will reach National Bank on Oct 9.
- Foreign investors have neither the time nor the money to fight Romanian red tape.
TINERETUL LIBER
- Government suggested 5.0 percent wage indexation for state employees in last quarter of 1996.
- Romania will get $24 million World Bank loan to rehabilitate roads.

- Government approved decree on creation of state reserves of 2.0 million tonnes of maize, 200,000 tonnes of sugar, 500,000 tonnes of sunflower seeds and 200 tonnes of powder milk and butter. Companies contributing to creation of reserves can get loans at 15 percent preference interest rate.
LIBERTATEA
- Banca Agricola SA commercial bank will launch credit cards in last quarter of 1996.
- Romania gets an annual $9.0 per capita from tourism.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- National Bank licensed new bank Astra based in Transylvanian city of Brasov.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Mosquitos which transmit the virus causing Romania's worst meningitis epidemic live in dump basements and near lakes, the paper says.
- President Ion Iliescu to run also for senator of ruling Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) in November elections.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- More than half of PDSR MPs were dropped from party lists for November 3 elections.
- Cabinet suggested a five percent wage indexation in the fourth quarter.
- Government drafted bill to turn assets of youth NGOs into state property
ADEVARUL
- Some 20 people to be tried for alleged tax evasion, fraud and bribery in grain trafficking case which caused 1.5 billion lei losees to state budget.
- Nicu Ceausescu, youngest son of former Stalinist dictator Nicolae Ceausescu, is hospitalised in Allgemeine Krankhaus in Vienna, waiting for liver transplant.
- Police arrested network of car thieves.
JURNALUL NATIONAL
- Homosexuality should be delt with by doctors not by provisions of criminal code, Socialist Labour Party leader Adrian Paunescu said. -- Bucharest newsroom 40-1 3120264
